_comment: Locators of the data grid every page has (GridLibrary), written for AG Grid's standard markup: column headers .ag-header-cell with col-id, rows .ag-row with row-index, cells .ag-cell with col-id. Adjust the selectors here if the grid differs; GridLibrary builds its row and cell lookups from them. Healing is off: grid content changes with the data.

headerCell.description: the column header showing HEADER; its col-id names the column's cells

loadingOverlay.description: the grid's loading overlay (only there while loading)

rowsOrNoRows.description: a data row, or the 'no rows' message: one of them is there once the grid has loaded

row.description: a grid row; its row-index is the same in the pinned and the scrolling part

cell.description: a grid cell; its col-id is the column's col-id

checkbox.description: a checkbox inside a row or cell

radio.description: a radio button inside a row or cell (element type for GridLibrary.element)

button.description: a button inside a row or cell (element type for GridLibrary.element)

link.description: a link inside a row or cell (element type for GridLibrary.element)

input.description: a text input inside a row or cell, for editable cells (element type for GridLibrary.element)

dropdown.description: a dropdown inside a row or cell (element type for GridLibrary.element)

image.description: an image inside a row or cell (element type for GridLibrary.element)
